description: CAD workspace inspection and geometry file translation (STEP/FCStd/SCAD to STL).
author: Charon Librarian

export_cad_to_stl.description: Translates parametric CAD source files (STEP, FCStd, SCAD) into STL geometry files.

source_file.description: Path to the input CAD geometry file.

output_path.description: Optional custom output path for the generated STL file.

dry_run.description: Simulate CAD conversion without writing files.

inspect_cad_files.description: Indexes and reports CAD, STL, 3MF, and G-Code artifacts within a target workspace or project directory.

project_name.description: Target project directory or name to scan for fabrication assets.
